data.exact_reserve_text: 2022 is the YOA closing at this point with an NCOR of 96.6% which is 8.0pp above plan. As of 1 January 2025, the Syndicate has successfully externally Reinsured-to-Close the 2022 and prior underwriting years into Syndicate 3500, managed by Riverstone Managing Agency Limited. This crystalises the result for the Syndicate on these years providing certainty and therefore removes the risks associated with the market backdrop described above and no liabilities on the 2022 and prior underwriting years will be passed to the Syndicate's open underwriting years.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased from $406.165m at the opening of the year to $468.829m at 31 December 2024 (gross change $+62.664m). The report does not present an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure; the syndicate instead discusses closure of 2022 and prior years via an external RITC (completed after year end) and attributes reserve and underwriting volatility to a series of large natural catastrophes, geopolitical events and post-COVID inflation which affected construction-related claims. No quantified gross prior-year release/strengthening is provided in the technical movement notes, and therefore prior-year development is not separately reported in gross terms in the file.
raw_causal_phrases: we experienced the effects of Hurricane Ian, the second largest insured catastrophe loss of all time, the outbreak of the Ukrainian War with Russia, and the heights of the post-Covid inflationary environment that year, with a particularly strong impact on the construction segments of our portfolio,

another year which again contained over $100bn of insured market losses, including the most expensive year on record for severe convective storm activity in the US, Hurricane Idalia, wildfires in Hawaii, the cyclones and flooding in Australia and New Zealand, and the Turkish earthquake.

As of 1 January 2025, the Syndicate has successfully externally Reinsured-to-Close the 2022 and prior underwriting years into Syndicate 3500, managed by Riverstone Managing Agency Limited. This crystalises the result for the Syndicate on these years providing certainty and therefore removes the risks associated with the market backdrop described above and no liabilities on the 2022 and prior underwriting years will be passed to the Syndicate's open underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was provided in the financial statements. The opening gross claims outstanding (406.165m) and closing gross claims outstanding (468.829m) are taken from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities). The gross change in claims outstanding during the year (+62.664m) is reported but includes current year development and payments and therefore does not represent a clean prior-year-only movement. No gross prior-year development figure is presented; consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. The syndicate did complete an external RITC for 2022 and prior years after year-end (1 Jan 2025) which crystallises results for those years and may affect comparability. A claims development triangle was not provided in numeric form in the available pages.
